notes.title: This cartoony cats vs. dogs RTS asserts that humanity's companions cannot live in harmony
notes.notes: s part of the 2022 Realms Deep digital event, developers Slipgate Ironworks and 2B Games have announced their collaborative project, Warpaws⁠—a cartoony RTS about a theoretical 20th century conflict between humankind's beloved companions, cats and dogs. It presents itself as a tactics-first, more streamlined RTS with a "focus on unit management, with no resources or complicated base building.".. Read more.

notes.title: Take part in the never-ending war of Dogs and Cats!
notes.notes:
[b]Warpaws[/b], the real-time strategy game where dogs and cats duke it out in a lighthearted alternate world using WWII-inspired armaments, developed by [b]Slipgate Ironworks[/b] and [b]2B Games[/b] and published by [b]Fulqrum Publishing[/b], lets fur fly on PC in 2023.

[previewyoutube=7k4gUTv_YKk;full][/previewyoutube]

Time to answer the age-old question: what’s better, cats or dogs? [b]Warpaws[/b] invites us to find out in all-out war through the lens of classic, cartoon-inspired art with slapstick. Command canine corps or feline forces and utilize superior planning and strategic abilities to capture key control points from enemy units to dominate the map. 

Unleash strategic carnage with 16 different units in five battle-torn biomes. Deploy spies for stealthy showdowns, send bazooka-wielding soldiers to dominate skirmishes on sand dunes, or assemble a mix of gunners, engineers, and fiery pyros suited for any engagement. Each unit stands on its own; instead of replacing them with direct upgrades, all characters have their own specialties.

Battle through a [b]single-player[/b] campaign or compete against other players in a variety of [b]multiplayer[/b] modes. Call upon a trusted ally and take down AI forces in a co-op mode, duke it out in [b]online versus mode[/b] matches, or become the King of the Hill champion. Master each map — Desert, Polar, Lava, City, Islands — and take advantage of terrain. Destroy frozen lakes to drown platoons, lead opponents into snowstorms, or even trick them into swimming with sharks.

To follow all the news about [b]Warpaws[/b], follow Fulqrum Publishing on their [url=https://linktr.ee/fulqrumpublishing]Social Media[/url], Slipgate Ironworks on their [url=https://slipgate-studios.com/]website[/url] and 2B Games on their [url=https://2b-games.com/]website[/url].
